text: A psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth.
Serve the LORD with gladness; come before him with joyful song.
Know that the LORD is God. He made us, and we are his; we are his people and the sheep of his pasture.

versions.text: Know that the LORD is God. He made us, and we are his; we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew joins the two final phrases with a conjunction (עַמּוֹ וְצֹאן מַרְעִיתוֹ), so 'his people and the sheep of his pasture' reflects the text more closely and reads more smoothly aloud. A footnote could also note the written Hebrew tradition reads 'and not we ourselves' while the read tradition, followed here, reads 'and we are his.'

text: Enter his gates with thanksgiving, his courts with praise; give thanks to him, bless his name.
For the LORD is good; his steadfast love endures forever, and his faithfulness to all generations.
